svg.text: Weak entity type (identified through its owner)
Identifying relationship of a weak entity
Partial key of a weak entity (dashed underline)
Total participation: every A takes part in R
Partial participation: an A may take no part
Cardinality ratio: the number beside an entity counts
that entity per instance on the other side. Each game
runs on 1 platform; a platform has N games.
Specialization: d in the circle means disjoint (an instance
belongs to at most one subclass); the double line means total
(every instance belongs to one). The cup on each line marks
the subclass as a subset of the superclass. A defining
attribute, when written beside the line, decides the subclass.
